top: Kimbo, a Great Pyrenees in New Mexico, faced possible euthanasia in August. People protested to give him a second chance.
comment: He finished training and his trainer adopted him. Now he goes to work with her every day. She says he just had to learn “I belong somewhere” 🥹
topic_it: Kimbo, Great Pyrenees di 3 anni (Santa Fe), rischiava l'eutanasia ad agosto; proteste 'Justice for Kimbo', addestramento a Sit Means Sit Albuquerque, adottato dalla co-manager Hannah Smith che lo porta al lavoro ogni giorno
title: The dog nobody wanted now goes to work every day #rescuedog #doglove #heartwarming
description: Kimbo faced possible euthanasia in August; after training he was adopted by his trainer, who now takes him to work every day.
